double_needs_position.name: double_needs_position
double_needs_position.value:
("seat"."berth_type" <> 'SLEEPER_DOUBLE')
    OR ("seat"."sofa_group_id" IS NOT NULL AND "seat"."sofa_position" IS NOT NULL)

held_needs_hold.name: held_needs_hold
held_needs_hold.value: "trip_seat_state"."status" <> 'HELD' OR ("trip_seat_state"."hold_id" IS NOT NULL AND "trip_seat_state"."held_until" IS NOT NULL)
